instruction_scope.scope: Inspection of the named AArch64 successful/error-path read-plan symbol in the retained release executable. Does not inspect every callee or the complete application, and does not establish whole-path energy or matrix-free mathematical structure.

projection.json.purpose: Five bounded continuation tracks: exact optimizer/data checkpoint, causal feedback supervision, learned relative Q8 action with controls, broader prose/dialogue/Rust training, compiled sparse readout and cost

training_sources: Project Gutenberg pg98 A Tale of Two Cities
tune_sources: Project Gutenberg pg35 The Time Machine
final_sources: Project Gutenberg pg74 The Adventures of Tom Sawyer
Project Gutenberg pg219 Heart of Darkness
data-plan.json.book_revision: Resolve once before download; store returned commit and unmodified bytes.
data-plan.json.authored_dialogue_code: Finite prompt/answer templates generated in Rust with declared disjoint values; evaluate exact emitted text and compile only model-generated Rust. Not natural instruction-following qualification.
data-plan.json.training_windows: 64-token nonoverlapping windows, prefix8, deterministic bounded even-stride selection; repository rehearsal retained separately.
data-plan.json.final_evaluation: Freeze the trained candidate by grounding plus tune loss before using final sources. Retain all negative generated outputs and exact source hashes. No fresh claim for the four books from the previous session.
data-plan.json.runtime: Native Rust tokenizer/model/training. Downloads and independent auditing may use shell/Python; they do not implement the model.

fitting-protocol.json.learning_rate: linear 0.01 to 0.001; fresh optimizer at start; exact moments/schedule/RNG on resume
fitting-protocol.json.batch: 3 repository prose,3 new-source prose/code,1 authored instruction,2 grounded,2 class-copy examples
fitting-protocol.json.withheld_cells: feedback_index == (source_index+2)%4; four opposite-class pairs excluded from both arms' draws
fitting-protocol.json.selection: Among64-step checkpoints, smallest new-source Tune loss subject to temporal32/32,class4/4,legacy-heldout3/3 and, for intervention arm,16/16 crossed feedback. Those legacy/diagnostic panels are exposed development gates, not a fresh final test.
fitting-protocol.json.final_sources: Score the already-declared final source set only after candidate choice is frozen. If no candidate meets gates, preserve failures and score predeclared terminal artifacts as failed exploratory candidates without promoting them.
fitting-protocol.json.exact_resume: Replay intervention steps129..256 in a separate process from checkpoint128 plus its bound control/selection companion; compare final latent/moment checkpoint, served artifact and selected artifact bytes.
fitting-protocol.json.geometry: Separate bounded relation-conditioned vector learner, ordinary signed-permutation fit with same supervision; not the numerical cause of prose results.
fitting-protocol.json.cost: Prompt ingestion plus generated-token loops; compare exact sequences before claiming speed; isolate zero-allocation readout from allocating recurrent updates.

final-evaluation-freeze.json.selection_rule: Lowest new-source Tune loss among checkpoints satisfying the predeclared grounding and causal gates; both selections are step256. No final-source loss used to select any candidate.
final-evaluation-freeze.json.final_population: The source files predeclared in data-plan.json: pg74,pg219 and Rust Book ownership chapter.16 evenly spread64-token windows per source; first8 observed; remaining56 scored. Rust chapter is source-file-separated within the same book, not an independent publisher/family.
final-evaluation-freeze.json.expected_reporting: Report each source, aggregate loss, every generated failure and comparison with both parent and matched ordinary arm. No adaptation after opening the final scores; no claim that the historical grounding gates are fresh.
final-evaluation-freeze.json.resume: Separate-process continuation from step128 running in parallel; production candidate is already fixed, and replay may only verify or falsify equality.

limits: Crossed withheld combinations are gradient-withheld but used as an exposed selection gate
Historical grounding cases are regression data
Strong ordinary geometric control matches Q8
Pre-tokenized prompt/generation timing is not full application or energy measurement
Successful read-plan call is allocation-free; recurrence and preparation still allocate
